definition.gross: median annual Ejari rent divided by median sale price for the same cell
definition.net: rent after vacancy, less service charge, management, maintenance and amortised purchase costs, over the full acquisition cost including fees
definition.cell: area, property type and bedroom count, over the same recent window

assumptions.label: Vacancy allowance
assumptions.description: Share of the year a unit is expected to sit empty between tenancies. Applied to rent, not to price, because an empty unit still costs its owner the service charge.
assumptions.source: Assumption. Ejari records contracts, not the gaps between them, so vacancy cannot be measured from the open data and has to be assumed.

assumptions.label: Service charge
assumptions.unit: AED per square metre per year
assumptions.description: Annual owners-association charge. Varies widely by building; DLD publishes actual per-building figures through the Mollak system, which would replace this estimate.
assumptions.source: Assumption pending a Mollak per-building feed.

assumptions.label: Property management
assumptions.description: Agency fee for managing a let, where the owner does not self-manage.

assumptions.label: Maintenance and repairs
assumptions.unit: fraction of property value per year
assumptions.description: Owner-borne upkeep beyond the service charge.

assumptions.label: DLD transfer fee
assumptions.description: Paid once on purchase. Conventionally split with the seller in practice, but the buyer customarily bears it in full, which is the assumption used here.

assumptions.label: Registration and trustee fees
assumptions.description: Title registration and trustee office charges on transfer.

assumptions.label: Holding period for amortising purchase costs
assumptions.description: One-off purchase costs are spread over an assumed holding period so they can be charged against an annual yield. A shorter hold makes those costs bite harder each year.

sql.prices: select area_key, property_type, rooms, count(*) as n_sales, median(price_aed) as median_price, median(area_sqm) as median_sqm, median(price_per_sqm) as median_ppsqm, stddev_samp(price_aed) as price_sd, max(ts) as last_sale from transactions where ts >= (select max(ts) from transactions) - interval '12' month and price_aed is not null and area_sqm is not null group by 1, 2, 3
sql.rents: select area_key, property_type, rooms, count(*) as n_contracts, median(annual_rent_aed) as median_rent, median(area_sqm) as median_rent_sqm, stddev_samp(annual_rent_aed) as rent_sd, max(start) as last_contract from rent_contracts where start >= (select max(start) from rent_contracts) - interval '12' month and annual_rent_aed is not null group by 1, 2, 3
